text:
anya.design: Dropping a short thread on nocturne palette + syntax highlighting for dashboards. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/nocturne-1234. Please quick-react, main questions are chart color separability and inline code legibility.
zoe.design: I like the deeper neutral background, but inline code at 12px looks washed out. Suggest adding a tiny pill bg for inline snippets. :mag_right:
mike.eng: Pill is doable but adds DOM wrappers in our markdown renderer. For charts we prefer adjusting hexes so canvas draw stays single-pass. Can you paste tokens?
anya.design: tokens snapshot:
--bg: #06090b; --surface: #0d1113; --text-muted: #98a6ac; --text: #e7f2f4; --code-bg: #071219; --code-fg: #bfeaff; --accent-1: #1fb29f; --accent-2: #ff6b5a; --accent-3: #f2b700
keiko.a11y: Automated contrast check: --text-muted on --surface = 3.0:1 (fails). code-fg on code-bg = 4.7:1 (marginal for inline). Recommend raising --text-muted or add pill. Also add --focus-ring token.
luis.data: Colorblind sim: accent-1 vs accent-2 low separation in protanomaly. Suggest accent-1 -> #00b39f, accent-2 -> #ff5a50. That keeps distinct luminance for canvas.\o
zoe.design: Two quick options: A) bump --text-muted to #c6d7db and update accents to luis' suggestion (minimal engineering work), or B) keep muted but implement inline pill + 1px halo on chart lines (harder perf-wise).
mike.eng: Vote A. Simple token changes are cheaper and safer for charts.
anya.design: Agreed. I'll prepare token PR with: --text-muted: #c6d7db, --accent-1: #00b39f, --accent-2: #ff5a50, add --focus-ring: #ffd86b, note inline pill as follow-up. Will tag @keiko.a11y for checklist.
design-bot: Created design comment on 'Nocturne Charts' frame by anya.design: "Token update PR incoming; tests requested."
keiko.a11y: I'll add a short smoke test list for the PR (contrast spots, keyboard focus, inline code checks, chart legend readability).
anya.design: Thanks all 44d. If no objections by EOD I'll merge the token PR.
